notes_on_manual_verification: Filled in by hand from the real Benchmark 2024-V7 Mortgage Trust 424B2 prospectus (Certificate Summary and Summary of Terms) and cross-checked against the deal's Pooling and Servicing Agreement (Exhibit 4.1 to Form 8-K/A, filed 2024-05-30) for the Master Servicer/Special Servicer/Trustee names. Ratings are intentionally left as low-confidence placeholders, matching the same convention as the VW ABS ground truth. final_scheduled_payment_date is null for every class because this summary states only one deal-wide rated final distribution date (May 2056, no exact day) rather than a per-class date -- a genuine structural difference from the ABS deal's per-tranche dates. cutoff_date and first_payment_date are null for the same reason: this summary states a cutoff value but not an exact cutoff date, and states 'commencing in June 2024' without a specific day. Class A-3, Class A-S, and Class B are rate-capped at the pool's weighted average coupon (WAC/WAC Cap) rather than truly fixed or indexed-floating -- classified here as 'floating' since the rate varies with the pool, which is the more defensible reading under this project's binary fixed/floating schema, but this is a real schema limitation worth stating plainly: neither label is a clean fit for a WAC-linked rate.
